task.description:
WF-02 Step 03b (TEST-DESIGN-VALIDATOR hard gate) for PW-13 Batch 1.

Validate the 5 test files:
(a) Every MUST acceptance criterion from RND-UI-01..04 has at least one runnable test
(b) No SkipTest or .todo on any test for MUST requirements
(c) Tests are self-sufficient (no shared mutable state between tests)
(d) classifyError.test.ts covers all 7 HTTP status cases including the 429 edge (with/without Retry-After)
(e) PermissionDenied.test.tsx verifies no HTTP status, no UUID, no backend message in rendered text
(f) Tests are wired into the test run (can be discovered by the test runner)

Return PASS if all 6 checks pass.

result.summary: All 6 checks PASS for RND-UI-01..04 (PW-13 Batch 1). (a) Every MUST requirement has at least one implemented runnable test: classifyError.test.ts covers RND-UI-01 classification logic (TC-CE-01..07), QueryStateBoundary.test.tsx covers RND-UI-01 state rendering and exhaustive union (TC-QSB-00..06), SkeletonLayout.test.tsx covers RND-UI-02 (TC-SK-01..04), FetchError.test.tsx covers RND-UI-03 (TC-FE-01..03), PermissionDenied.test.tsx covers RND-UI-04 (TC-PD-01..05). (b) No skip, no .todo markers in any test block. (c) All tests use afterEach(cleanup)/vi.clearAllMocks(); no shared mutable state across test blocks. (d) classifyError.test.ts covers all 7 cases: 401, 403, 409, 429+retryAfter (rate-limit), 429-no-retryAfter (fetch-failure), 500, network error. (e) PermissionDenied.test.tsx: TC-PD-03 asserts no HTTP status numbers, TC-PD-04 asserts no UUID-shaped strings, TC-PD-05 asserts no /40[13]/ match, TC-PD-01 verifies exact fixed copy (implicit no-backend-message). (f) All 5 files match vitest default discovery pattern (*.test.{ts,tsx}); the npm test command excludes only tests/e2e/**, not tests/unit/**.
result.next_action: PASS: ORCH dispatches step-04-test-runner | FAIL: rework TEST-DESIGNER
